expectations.name: author-from-a-vague-idea
expected_behavior: Loads the Company Glossary's term set with `glossary_terms` before drafting
Interviews one branch at a time — objective, UI change, in/out of scope, the rules — rather than drafting straight from the one-line idea
Rewrites a vague requirement ("resets must be secure") into a verifiable one per REQ-6 — a measurable threshold, its figure supplied by the user when asked rather than made up
Keeps each requirement atomic per REQ-1

Produces the sections in this order — the metadata block, `[[TOC]]`, the RFC 2119 / RFC 8174 keyword notice, `## Introduction`, `## Glossary` (only if a term needs defining), `## Scope` holding `### In Scope` then `### Out of Scope`, `## Requirements` — with Status `IN PROGRESS` and marked TODO placeholders for Owners, Initiative, and Designs
Every count the reply states — the requirement-group counts at least — matches the SRD it describes

expectations.name: undocumented-platform-fact
expected_behavior: Searches the corpus before accepting the claim, and neither silently accepts nor silently corrects it: the branch restatement or the final report says the docs do not confirm it
Hands the unconfirmable claim to `report-doc-gap` as a draft, and the confirmed fact to `kb` once the user confirms it in the branch restatement

Neither hand-off interrupts the interview: no turn between the claim and the next branch is about the gap or about banking or filing either one. A question about the requirement itself is not an interruption

Never asks permission to bank the fact — no "should I record this?" prompt. Confirming the requirement confirms the fact, and `srd:kb` writes it to the inbox silently. Ordinary elicitation ("is three the count today?") is a requirement question, not a banking prompt, and does not breach this

Folds a proposed SRD path under `initiatives` into the branch restatement that follows the gap, and once it is confirmed has `report-doc-gap` set the draft's `srd_ref` — no draft is left without a path
At the write step, writes to that path and invokes `report-doc-gap` to offer the draft gap

Writes no requirement the interview did not attest: every rule in the SRD traces to something the persona stated, and a behaviour nobody mentioned does not appear because it would round the feature out

expectations.name: start-costs-nothing-before-the-interview
expected_behavior: Passes the gate and, with no SRD path named, runs no draft check and invokes neither `srd:report-doc-gap` nor `srd:kb` at step 0
Calls no `glossary_terms` before the interview opens, and loads the term set once the first term surfaces — at the latest with the user's first answer, and always before drafting
Restates the seed as the opening Objective and asks the next branch, rather than narrating a startup sequence
